name: jewelcraft
description: Teaches Claude to model and check jewelry in Blender with the JewelCraft add-on over a Blender MCP connection — prong grip, seat clearance and stone overlaps measured rather than eyeballed, ring sizes read from the band's actual inner surface, metal weight with overlapping parts counted once, print/cast checks that confirm an STL comes out in millimetres, and metalwork built from editable paths fused with Geometry Nodes, split into a cast part and a hand-built wire head with a 1:1 bending template, with the add-on's scripting traps documented and worked around
